describe: Hidden text that uncovers letter by letter as a progress number rises. Requires state `reveal_progress: int` (bind it to `score`, or to any int the game raises, and keep it from going down); every `per_piece` of progress uncovers one more character, left to right, and spaces are always shown. Provides `reveal_text` (string, starts as the param `text`; a game with its words in `content` sets it on `start`), `revealed` (characters uncovered so far, 0 to the text length), and emits `fully_revealed` once. With `wins` true, revealing everything wins. The text is cut into lines of `wrap` characters (up to 4 lines, so at most 4 x `wrap` characters) and drawn from (`x`, `y`) in the `layer` (playfield or overlay). Hidden letters show as a dot.

template.text: = join(map(slice(chars(reveal_text), k * @wrap, (k + 1) * @wrap), (ch, j) => if ch == ' ' or k * @wrap + j < revealed then ch else '•'), '')
